query: SELECT * FROM duckdb_tables() WHERE database_name='nhl' ORDER BY schema_name,table_name
rows: Current top-ten NHL goalies per stat category

rows.vgi.doc_llm: The NHL's current top ten goalies in each category (wins, savePctg, goalsAgainstAverage, shutouts), one row per category and rank with the stat in value.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Current goalie leaderboards in long format: filter on `category`.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Current save-percentage leaders.", "sql": "SELECT rank, player_name, team_abbrev, value AS save_pct FROM nhl.main.current_goalie_leaders WHERE category = 'savePctg' ORDER BY rank"}]
rows.vgi.title: Current NHL Goalie Leaders

rows: CREATE TABLE current_goalie_leaders(season INTEGER, game_type INTEGER, category VARCHAR, rank INTEGER, player_id INTEGER, player_name VARCHAR, first_name VARCHAR, last_name VARCHAR, sweater_number INTEGER, "position" VARCHAR, team_abbrev VARCHAR, team_name VARCHAR, "value" DOUBLE, PRIMARY KEY(category, rank));
NHL games in the seven days starting today, one row per game

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Every NHL game in the seven days starting today, one row per game, with start time, teams, venue, state, and scores once played. Use schedule(date := ...) for another week and team_schedule() for one club's season.
rows.vgi.doc_md: This week's NHL games as a read-only table. Scores are NULL until a game starts.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "This week's games in start order.", "sql": "SELECT game_date, start_time_utc, away_team_abbrev, home_team_abbrev, venue FROM nhl.main.current_schedule ORDER BY start_time_utc"}]
rows.vgi.title: This Week's NHL Schedule

rows: CREATE TABLE current_schedule(game_id BIGINT, season INTEGER, game_type INTEGER, game_date DATE, start_time_utc TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, venue VARCHAR, venue_timezone VARCHAR, neutral_site BOOLEAN, game_state VARCHAR, game_schedule_state VARCHAR, away_team_id INTEGER, away_team_abbrev VARCHAR, away_team_name VARCHAR, away_score INTEGER, away_shots_on_goal INTEGER, home_team_id INTEGER, home_team_abbrev VARCHAR, home_team_name VARCHAR, home_score INTEGER, home_shots_on_goal INTEGER, period INTEGER, period_type VARCHAR, last_period_type VARCHAR, winning_goalie_id INTEGER, winning_goalie_name VARCHAR, winning_goal_scorer_id INTEGER, winning_goal_scorer_name VARCHAR, game_center_url VARCHAR, PRIMARY KEY(game_id));
Today's NHL games with live or final scores, one row per game

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Today's NHL scoreboard, one row per game: state (FUT, LIVE, CRIT, OFF), score, shots on goal, period, and how a finished game ended. Use scores(date := ...) for another day and box_score(game_id) for detail.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Today's NHL games with live or final scores.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Today's scoreboard.", "sql": "SELECT away_team_abbrev, away_score, home_team_abbrev, home_score, game_state, period FROM nhl.main.current_scores ORDER BY start_time_utc"}]
rows.vgi.title: Today's NHL Scores

rows: CREATE TABLE current_scores(game_id BIGINT, season INTEGER, game_type INTEGER, game_date DATE, start_time_utc TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, venue VARCHAR, venue_timezone VARCHAR, neutral_site BOOLEAN, game_state VARCHAR, game_schedule_state VARCHAR, away_team_id INTEGER, away_team_abbrev VARCHAR, away_team_name VARCHAR, away_score INTEGER, away_shots_on_goal INTEGER, home_team_id INTEGER, home_team_abbrev VARCHAR, home_team_name VARCHAR, home_score INTEGER, home_shots_on_goal INTEGER, period INTEGER, period_type VARCHAR, last_period_type VARCHAR, winning_goalie_id INTEGER, winning_goalie_name VARCHAR, winning_goal_scorer_id INTEGER, winning_goal_scorer_name VARCHAR, game_center_url VARCHAR, PRIMARY KEY(game_id));
Current top-ten NHL skaters per stat category

rows.vgi.doc_llm: The NHL's current top ten skaters in each category (points, goals, assists, plusMinus, goalsPp, goalsSh, penaltyMins, faceoffLeaders, toi), one row per category and rank with the stat in value. During the playoffs the NHL reports playoff leaders (game_type 3).
rows.vgi.doc_md: Current skater leaderboards in long format: filter on `category`.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Current scoring race.", "sql": "SELECT rank, player_name, team_abbrev, value AS points FROM nhl.main.current_skater_leaders WHERE category = 'points' ORDER BY rank"}]
rows.vgi.title: Current NHL Skater Leaders

rows: CREATE TABLE current_skater_leaders(season INTEGER, game_type INTEGER, category VARCHAR, rank INTEGER, player_id INTEGER, player_name VARCHAR, first_name VARCHAR, last_name VARCHAR, sweater_number INTEGER, "position" VARCHAR, team_abbrev VARCHAR, team_name VARCHAR, "value" DOUBLE, PRIMARY KEY(category, rank));
Today's NHL standings, one row per team

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Today's NHL standings, one row per team. Start here for points, record (W-L-OTL), point percentage, goal differential, division/conference/wild-card rank, streaks, and clinch markers. For standings on another date call standings(date := ...).
rows.vgi.doc_md: Today's NHL standings as an ordinary read-only table. `division_rank`, `conference_rank`, and `league_rank` follow the NHL's official tiebreaking order.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Current division tables in official order.", "sql": "SELECT division_name, division_rank, team_abbrev, points, games_played FROM nhl.main.current_standings ORDER BY division_name, division_rank"}, {"description": "Eastern Conference wild-card race.", "sql": "SELECT wildcard_rank, team_abbrev, points, games_played FROM nhl.main.current_standings WHERE conference_name = 'Eastern' AND wildcard_rank > 0 ORDER BY wildcard_rank"}]
rows.vgi.title: Current NHL Standings

rows: CREATE TABLE current_standings(season INTEGER, game_type INTEGER, standings_date DATE, team_abbrev VARCHAR, team_name VARCHAR, team_common_name VARCHAR, team_place_name VARCHAR, conference_abbrev VARCHAR, conference_name VARCHAR, division_abbrev VARCHAR, division_name VARCHAR, league_rank INTEGER, conference_rank INTEGER, division_rank INTEGER, wildcard_rank INTEGER, games_played INTEGER, wins INTEGER, losses INTEGER, ot_losses INTEGER, "ties" INTEGER, points INTEGER, point_pct DOUBLE, regulation_wins INTEGER, regulation_plus_ot_wins INTEGER, shootout_wins INTEGER, shootout_losses INTEGER, goals_for INTEGER, goals_against INTEGER, goal_differential INTEGER, home_wins INTEGER, home_losses INTEGER, home_ot_losses INTEGER, home_points INTEGER, road_wins INTEGER, road_losses INTEGER, road_ot_losses INTEGER, road_points INTEGER, last_10_wins INTEGER, last_10_losses INTEGER, last_10_ot_losses INTEGER, streak_code VARCHAR, streak_count INTEGER, clinch_indicator VARCHAR, team_logo_url VARCHAR, PRIMARY KEY(team_abbrev));
Every NHL franchise, active and defunct

rows.vgi.doc_llm: One row per NHL franchise with its latest name. A franchise spans relocations and renames (Quebec Nordiques to Colorado Avalanche); the teams table maps team ids to franchise ids.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Active and defunct franchises from the NHL stats service.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "All NHL franchises alphabetically.", "sql": "SELECT franchise_id, full_name FROM nhl.main.franchises ORDER BY full_name"}]
rows.vgi.title: NHL Franchises

rows: CREATE TABLE franchises(franchise_id INTEGER, full_name VARCHAR, common_name VARCHAR, place_name VARCHAR, PRIMARY KEY(franchise_id));
Every NHL season since 1917-18 with standings dates and rule flags

rows.vgi.doc_llm: One row per NHL season id (e.g. 20252026) since 1917-18 with the first and last standings dates and which rules applied: ties, OT-loss point, regulation wins, wild card, conferences, divisions. Use standings_end as the day for a season's final standings and season ids as the season argument of other functions.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Season ids, standings windows, and rule flags since 1917-18.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Seasons whose standings used the wild card, newest first.", "sql": "SELECT season, standings_start, standings_end FROM nhl.main.standings_seasons WHERE wildcard_in_use ORDER BY season DESC"}]
rows.vgi.title: NHL Seasons

rows: CREATE TABLE standings_seasons(season INTEGER, standings_start DATE, standings_end DATE, conferences_in_use BOOLEAN, divisions_in_use BOOLEAN, point_for_ot_loss_in_use BOOLEAN, regulation_wins_in_use BOOLEAN, row_in_use BOOLEAN, ties_in_use BOOLEAN, wildcard_in_use BOOLEAN, PRIMARY KEY(season));
Every current and historical NHL team with its id, tricode, and franchise

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Reference list of NHL team ids (the team_id used by team_stats(), scores, and box scores), three-letter tricodes, full names, and franchise ids, including relocated and defunct teams. Join franchises on franchise_id to group relocations.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Current and historical teams from the NHL stats service.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Every team that has played for the Avalanche/Nordiques franchise.", "sql": "SELECT t.team_id, t.full_name, t.tricode FROM nhl.main.teams t JOIN nhl.main.franchises f USING (franchise_id) WHERE f.common_name = 'Avalanche'"}]
rows.vgi.title: NHL Teams

rows: CREATE TABLE teams(team_id INTEGER, franchise_id INTEGER, full_name VARCHAR, tricode VARCHAR, league_id INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(team_id));
